places-abrigo-de-los-covachos-cueva-del-.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-abrigo-de-los-covachos-cueva-del-.story: From Nerpio it runs 247 km to Nerpio; allow about 4 h 16 of riding. On the way it passes Cueva de las Palamas, Cueva del Tio Labrador and back through Cueva de las Palamas. The highest point is about 1,400 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
